verdicts.why: In S3E10 'Karen', Fisk learns from his FBI agents that Karen is at Clinton Church and orders Dex to kill her for Wesley; Dex attacks the church dressed as Daredevil.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#1
value.text: Montana and the Enforcers, hired by the Big Man to kill Spider-Man, attack him while he fights the Vulture. Spider-Man beats the others, but Montana escapes.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The hero Montana is hired to kill.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An Enforcer hired to kill Peter.

split.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#4
split.text: Montana fights Spider-Man as the Shocker in a trap at a landfill and knocks him into a machine, leaving him for dead.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The hero Montana tries to kill as the Shocker.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An Enforcer who attacks Peter at a landfill as the Shocker.

verdicts.why: #25 is wrong, but #4 is not the start either: Montana first appears in episode 1, where the Big Man sends the Enforcers to kill Spider-Man and Montana nets him and escapes. The stage moves to #1 and the Shocker fight from #4 becomes its own stage.

value.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#22
value.text: Montana fights Spider-Man again as the Shocker alongside the new Enforcers, whom the Tinkerer has armed with new gear.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fights Peter again with the new Enforcers.

verdicts.why: Episode 22 'Probable Cause' has Spider-Man face the Enforcers (Shocker, Fancy Dan, Ox) with new Tinkerer gear, but no source says Montana leads them, so 'leads' is cut.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
value.text: Davis serves under Mack once Mack becomes Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

verdicts.why: The boss stage starts even earlier than S6#1: in S5#22 'The End' Daisy chooses Mack to lead S.H.I.E.L.D., and Davis joins the new S.H.I.E.L.D. under him as its main pilot. The cut-back text and cards are right; Davis's death stays on its own S6#10 stage (n64).
S6#10 'Leap': the team learns Izel got into the Lighthouse through Davis; she hops between agents, drops Davis from a ledge to his death, then takes Mack.
At the end of S6#10 Yo-Yo lets Izel possess her and Izel makes Mack fly her away; by S6#11 Mack and Yo-Yo are already her prisoners at the temple.
In the first episode Janet takes a call from her lover Robert and they meet at the PRIDE gathering, so the affair is already under way; Victor only exposes it in episode 6.
In S1E6 'Metamorphosis' Victor uses his speech at the PRIDE gala to reveal the affair in public; Janet ends it in episode 7.

value.title: Agent Carter S2#2
value.text: Jason Wilkes and Whitney Frost fight over Isodyne's Zero Matter, and both are exposed to it in the struggle.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The woman Wilkes fights over Isodyne's Zero Matter.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The Isodyne scientist Whitney fights over the Zero Matter.

split.title: Agent Carter S2#7
split.text: Whitney Frost breaks into Howard Stark's estate and kidnaps Jason Wilkes to use in her Zero Matter experiments.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who kidnaps Wilkes for her Zero Matter experiments.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The scientist Whitney kidnaps to help with her Zero Matter work.

verdicts.why: The kidnapping is in S2#7, not #9, but the two are enemies from S2#2, where Frost confronts Wilkes at the Zero Matter and both are exposed in the struggle. So the stage starts at #2 and the kidnapping becomes its own #7 stage (the rift test stays at #8, n69).
In S2E8 Wilkes agrees to work with Frost; at the desert atomic test only Wilkes is pulled into the rift and comes back full of Zero Matter, to Frost's fury.

value.title: Agatha All Along#4
value.text: Rio Vidal is summoned as the coven's new Green Witch and walks the Witches' Road with Jennifer Kale.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The coven's Green Witch on the Road.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A witch Rio walks the Road with.

split.title: Agatha All Along#7
split.text: Lilia discovers that Rio, the coven's Green Witch, is Death, and tells Jen and the others.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The coven's Green Witch on the Road, who turns out to be Death.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A witch Rio walks the Road with, who learns Rio is Death.

verdicts.why: Jen's own spell summons Rio as the replacement Green Witch in episode 4, so the start is right. But the Death reveal comes in episode 7, when Lilia works it out and tells the group, so that fact is split onto a #7 stage instead of being dropped.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#5
value.text: Lucy Bauer, Eli Morrow's former colleague at Momentum Labs, kidnaps him during the South Ridge prison riot and forces him to read the Darkhold for her.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A former Momentum colleague who takes Eli hostage.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A former Momentum colleague Lucy takes hostage.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#6
split.text: Lucy reveals that Eli betrayed her at Momentum Labs, locking her in the experiment that turned her into a ghost.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Former Momentum colleague Eli made a ghost. Takes him hostage.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Former Momentum colleague who made Lucy a ghost. She takes him hostage.

verdicts.why: Lucy kidnaps Eli in S4#5 'Lockup', but his betrayal only comes out in S4#6: until then he blames an explosion, and Lucy reveals he made the ghosts himself. So the betrayal goes on its own #6 stage and is not a spoiler at #5. 'Arranged the attack' was also wrong: he locked her in the generator himself.

In S4E15 Simmons wakes Piper and makes her move out at gunpoint; Piper is about to stab her until she sees Mack's LMD torn apart, then evacuates agents before the base is blown up. Piper goes on Zephyr One's guns in S4E21.
The current text is not wrong: Christine and the Illuminati keep America in a cell at their headquarters, and Christine tries to free her when the Scarlet Witch attacks. The proposal only rewords it.

In S1E1 B-15 hands Casey the Tesseract to file. Loki later threatens to kill him for it, Casey hands it over, Loki sees the Infinity Stones in the drawer, and Casey says some employees use them as paperweights.

Kingpin forms the Insidious Six and leads it: he springs the villains to destroy Spider-Man, with Doctor Octopus and the Scorpion as fellow members. No source makes Doctor Octopus the Scorpion's leader.
In the final battle Ayo, Shuri, Nakia and Okoye are cornered by the Border Tribe until M'Baku's Jabari join the fight, so the film leaves Ayo and M'Baku on the same side.

In S2E10 Jessica helps Malus plan to flee to Uruguay rather than wanting him dead. In S2E11 Trish kidnaps him and forces the procedure on her; Jessica stops it, and Malus sets himself and his lab on fire.
The basis is wrong: in S1E7 Dooley tells Peggy she is to be dismissed from the SSR once Stark arrives, so 'fires her' has source support. The change is not clearly backed.
Episode 1 'Survival of the Fittest' is the first appearance of both Jameson and Betty Brant at the Daily Bugle, where Peter is thrown out of Jameson's office.
